title: Misty Reed Post
wikitext:
[[File:Misty Reed Post.jpg|thumb|300px|Misty Reed Post.]]

'''Misty Reed Post''' is a small [[Horde]] outpost of [[Stonard]] in the [[Swamp of Sorrows]]. It lies between the [[Stagalbog]] and the southern [[Misty Reed Strand]]. It is guarded by [[Tok'Kar]], along with [[Katar]], some [[Stonard Hunter]]s and a [[Stonard Shaman]]. Tok'Kar dreams that one day the post will get a [[burrow]] or at least a [[Watch tower|tower]]. There is no flight path from here.
